label: Milk permeate
note: Mostly lactose and minerals; like whey permeate it is dried and used as a cheap filler and sweetener base.

about.text: What passes through the membrane when skimmed milk is ultrafiltered to make milk protein: water, lactose and minerals, with no protein to speak of. It is dried or concentrated and used as a lactose and mineral ingredient.

links.name: ADPI: Dairy milk permeate; Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. Milk and whey fractionation

how.text: The membrane holds back the proteins and lets water, lactose, minerals and small nitrogen compounds through. That liquid is then concentrated and dried, often with a controlled crystallisation step first, into a powder of roughly 80 % lactose, 3 % protein and 8.5 % ash. It stands in for other dairy solids, sugar or corn syrup in bakery, pizza dough and confectionery, and is a lactose and mineral supply in animal feed.
